Job Requisition ID #

26WD100188

This role can be remote within the U.S. or Canada, though San Francisco is the preferred location

About The Team

At GET (Growth Experience Technology), we fuel sustainable growth by rethinking how customers discover, buy, and use Autodesk. Our focus is creating a seamless, data-driven experience that feels simple, predictable, and tailored to customer needs—while also making it easier and more efficient for our teams to support them. 

To get there, we're building smarter digital experiences, strengthening our platforms, and making our sales and marketing efforts much more efficient and connected. While the product experience will play a key role, a real unlock will come from the technologies that power better customer insights, more personalized engagement, and faster sales cycles. 

What you’ll do

The GET Applied AI organization is looking for a seasoned Senior Manager / Senior Principal of Applied AI Engineering
to lead the application of AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics across Autodesk’s B2C business. This role will play a critical leadership role in shaping how Autodesk uses data and AI to build the eCommerce and personalization platforms of the future.

Applied AI Engineers at Autodesk are both data/research scientists and software engineers, who develop and implement machine learning models and algorithms. Unlike other companies that separate these roles, our Applied AI Engineers work on projects from ideation to implementation.

As a Sr. Principal Applied AI Engineer at Autodesk, you will be responsible for the development and training of cutting-edge machine learning models and algorithms that can effectively leverage our users’ platform activities and industry trends to create personalized recommendations that are delivered to our users at the optimal moment.

As a senior leader within Applied AI, you will set technical and strategic direction, lead a portfolio of high-impact AI/ML initiatives, develop talent, and partner with senior business and technology leaders
to translate Autodesk’s business priorities into scalable AI capabilities.

You will be responsible for advancing machine learning solutions that leverage customer behavior, product engagement, commerce signals, and industry trends to create more relevant and personalized customer experiences. You will also help establish the organizational practices, technical standards, and operating mechanisms needed to scale Applied AI across Autodesk.

Responsibilities

Set the Applied AI Strategy – Define and drive the vision, roadmap, and investment priorities for key data science and machine learning capabilities across Autodesk’s B2C business, including personalization, recommendation systems, segmentation, forecasting, experimentation, churn prediction, product analytics, and customer insights.
Lead a Portfolio of High-Impact Initiatives – Own multiple complex, cross-functional AI/ML programs from strategy through production and business adoption. Establish clear priorities, success metrics, operating rhythms, and accountability to ensure the team delivers measurable customer and business outcomes.
Build and Develop a High-Performing Team – Provide leadership, coaching, and career development for Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers. Create an environment that attracts strong technical talent, raises the bar for execution, and enables individuals to grow in both technical depth and leadership.
Provide Technical Leadership – Establish technical direction and engineering standards for machine learning systems, model development, experimentation, evaluation, production deployment, and MLOps. Guide teams through complex technical decisions while ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with Autodesk’s broader technology architecture.
Expand Autodesk’s ML Capabilities – Identify emerging opportunities where AI and machine learning can materially improve the customer experience or business performance. Guide the design and development of scalable end-to-end ML platforms and pipelines that enable personalization and intelligent decision-making at scale.
Drive Experimentation at Scale – Establish robust experimentation and measurement practices that increase development velocity while maintaining scientific rigor. Enable teams to rapidly test hypotheses, evaluate model performance, quantify incremental impact, and translate learnings into product and business decisions.
Influence Senior Leadership – Serve as a trusted thought partner to senior leaders across Product, Engineering, eCommerce, Marketing, Finance, and other functions. Frame ambiguous business problems, identify opportunities where AI can create value, recommend investment priorities, and influence strategic decisions through data.
Drive Cross-Functional Execution – Initiate and lead large-scale, complex strategic initiatives spanning multiple teams and organizations. Build alignment across technical and business stakeholders, resolve ambiguity and competing priorities, and drive programs through execution and adoption.
Champion a Data- and AI-Driven Culture – Evangelize best practices in applied AI, machine learning, experimentation, and evidence-based decision-making. Help shape Autodesk’s broader approach to responsible, scalable, and business-oriented use of AI.
Translate Technology into Business Impact – Develop compelling narratives that connect data, model performance, customer behavior, and financial outcomes. Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to executive, business, and technical audiences and ensure AI investments are tied to measurable impact.
Raise the Organizational Bar – Establish reusable frameworks, processes, and best practices that improve how Applied AI teams prioritize work, evaluate opportunities, design solutions, and measure results. Foster collaboration and knowledge sharing across Data Science, ML Engineering, and adjacent technical organizations.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another related quantitative or technical field.
10+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied Research, or a related technical discipline, with significant experience delivering production-scale machine learning solutions.
Demonstrated experience leading teams, technical organizations, or major cross-functional programs, including setting strategy, establishing priorities, and driving execution across multiple simultaneous initiatives.
Experience developing technical talent through coaching, mentorship, technical leadership, performance management, or people management.
Proven ability to lead technical strategy, machine learning system design, and optimization of production-scale ML infrastructure, including model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, monitoring, debugging, and model optimization.
7+ years of experience with software or machine learning system design and architecture, including launching and operating production systems.
Deep hands-on experience with machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, recommendation or personalization systems, and applied statistical methods.
Strong expertise in A/B testing, experimental design, causal reasoning, and measurement.
Strong understanding of statistics, probability, customer and product analytics, and financial or business modeling.
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into data and AI strategies and connect technical investments to measurable customer and business impact.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills, with demonstrated ability to influence senior technical and business leaders.

Preferred Qualifications

MS or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline.
15+ years of experience in machine learning, data science, or related disciplines, ideally including experience in eCommerce, personalization, growth, digital products, or consumer-facing platforms.
5+ years of experience in technical or people leadership, including building and developing high-performing Data Science and/or Machine Learning Engineering teams.
Experience defining multi-year AI/ML strategies and translating them into organizational roadmaps, investment priorities, and measurable business outcomes.
Experience hiring, developing, and retaining senior Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and technical leaders.
Experience operating effectively in a matrixed environment and influencing senior executives across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and business organizations.
Hands-on experience with cloud machine learning platforms such as AWS or Azure and strong knowledge of modern MLOps, model governance, observability, and production ML best practices.
Experience building personalization, recommendation, ranking, forecasting, customer lifecycle, or next-best-action systems at significant scale.

Overview

Come join the TurboTax CRM and Lifecycle Marketing data science team as a Staff Data Scientist. We design how Intuit engages customers across owned channels to drive retention, product engagement, and long-term customer value. Our mission is to accelerate decision-making through advanced models, causal measurement, and experimentation that address our most important customer and business challenges.

This role will be pivotal in shifting CRM from campaign-level optimization to customer journey design: defining the metrics and causal levers the business manages to, designing learning plans that resolve the highest-stakes decisions, and building the measurement and data products the lifecycle marketing organization depends on. You will operate as a senior individual contributor, partnering closely with Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Tax leadership to identify, validate, and refine strategies that move customers through behavioral milestones — not just messages — and compound into retention and lifetime value.

The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of lifecycle marketing, causal inference, and AI-native analytics. You frame the right question before any analysis runs, with a command of the domain that others check their own framing against. This is a high-impact role where your work will directly influence how TurboTax invests in CRM, which journeys get built, and how we know they are working.

Responsibilities

Drive Lifecycle Marketing Strategy through Data — Frame the right question self-directed, before analysis is requested. Translate ambiguous marketing and product problems into analytical frameworks, metric trees, and testable hypotheses that alter the CRM roadmap and resource decisions. Partner with Tax leadership and the Lifecycle Marketing team to define north-star metrics, align on learning plans, and establish what success looks like at each stage of the customer journey — from re-engagement and start through completion, attach, and return the following year.

Causal Measurement that Changes Business Decisions — Apply causal inference and counterfactual reasoning to isolate what actually moved a metric — campaign incrementality, journey-level lift, channel mix, halo, and retention — and change the business-area decision it feeds. Design and run experiments, quasi-experiments, holdouts, and synthetic tests when a clean A/B is not available.

Cross-Functional Influence — Serve as the strategic data science partner to leaders across Marketing, Product, Data Engineering, Finance, and adjacent growth teams (paid acquisition, Credit Karma, in-product messaging). Translate complex analytical findings into clear recommendations for Director- and VP-level stakeholders, and drive the work through to the decision in whatever medium lands — slack, readout, model, or working session.

Insights, Journeys & Customer Value at Scale — Conduct deep-dive analyses on customer journeys, audience segments, funnel and cohort performance, and lifetime value to inform where CRM has the most leverage. Design segmentation and personalization strategies that improve targeting, reduce wasted volume, and free messaging capacity for high-value journeys. Create dashboards, visualizations, and self-serve tools — including GenAI-powered applications — so marketing and leadership can act quickly.

AI-Native Measurement, Data Products & Agentic Systems — Identify, size, and prioritize AI use cases for CRM (personalization, journey orchestration, insight generation) against business value, and apply evaluation frameworks (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge with human review, synthetic tests) so non-deterministic experiences can be certified rather than shipped on vibes. Build and maintain the data products the business area and its agents depend on: prototype the data model, pipeline, and surface, then partner with engineering to harden what sticks. Automate recurring analytical bottlenecks into trusted agentic systems that stakeholders can run independently, with encoded business logic, monitoring, and a clear call on what may run without a human in the loop. Champion data hygiene, instrumentation, and decision governance across CRM reporting and campaign measurement.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate is a curious, self-directed data scientist with experience building scalable solutions, a deep understanding of customer behavior, and the judgment to balance statistical rigor with business speed.

8+ years of experience in data science and analytics, with a track record of driving strategy and impact across a business area (CRM, lifecycle marketing, growth, retention, or equivalent); consumer subscription, fintech, or large-scale owned-channel marketing experience strongly preferred.
Demonstrated ability to apply first-principles thinking to translate ambiguous business strategy into analytical problems at the business-area level — framing the question before analysis runs, rather than waiting for one to be handed down.
Proven success designing and interpreting complex experiments well beyond traditional A/B testing, and applying causal inference where experimentation is constrained (holdouts, quasi-experiments, incrementality, MMM or multi-touch attribution as inputs — not substitutes — for causal claims).
Deep expertise in causal inference, customer segmentation, journey analytics, and experimentation design, with the judgment to balance statistical rigor and business considerations.
Experience building and owning predictive models through their lifecycle (classification, regression, propensity, or similar) and being accountable for the decisions they inform, not just model accuracy.
Experience creating reusable frameworks, methodologies, and data products that are adopted by a broader analytics and marketing community.
Fluency in SQL and a statistical programming language (Python or R); experience partnering with engineering to harden pipelines, instrumentation, and production data products.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder-influence skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence Director- and VP-level leaders across business and technical teams.
Ability to navigate ambiguity with minimal guidance, make fast data-driven decisions (one-way vs. two-way door), and operate effectively in a fast-paced, seasonal business.
Ability to use AI-native tools to plan, implement, and synthesize analyses across experiment readouts, quasi-experimental methods, revenue and retention deep dives, and measuring the success of journey or campaign launches. Comfort sizing AI use cases and evaluating non-deterministic systems, not only using AI as a personal productivity tool.
BS or MS in Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Engineering, Econometrics, or a related field (advanced degree preferred).

Nice to have

Hands-on experience with CRM platforms (e.g., Braze) and owned-channel measurement (email, push, SMS, in-app).
Experience designing journey-level measurement (behavioral milestones, coordinated intent) alongside campaign-level operational metrics.
Familiarity with marketing mix models, multi-touch attribution, and when not to treat them as causal evidence.

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Do you want to build agentic AI systems that reach real patients and inform real business decisions?

The Lilly USA Technology at Lilly Market Access team is seeking a Senior Principal Data Scientist to design and build the next generation of agentic AI and machine learning solutions across our employer-intelligence and real-world-evidence initiatives. You will work with internal business and Technology at Lilly partners to solve complex, high-volume problems with intelligent, autonomous, and measurable AI systems that scale horizontally across use cases.

What You'll Be Doing

As a Senior Principal Data Scientist, you will analyze complex data, develop predictive and generative models, and design agentic AI systems that solve genuine business problems in the employer and real-world-evidence spaces. You will own the AI reasoning layer end to end, from framing the problem and designing multi-agent workflows to building the models and evaluation frameworks that make these systems trustworthy. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand business problems, develop hypotheses, and test them with data and rigorous evaluation. You will build reusable, horizontal capabilities rather than one-off solutions.

How You'll Succeed

Design and build agentic AI systems, including agent-to-agent orchestration, multi-agent workflows, tool and environment use, and autonomous reasoning loops that act on real systems.

Build rigorous AI evaluation frameworks, including groundedness and hallucination measurement, benchmark design, regression testing, confidence and uncertainty estimation, and human-in-the-loop review, so AI behavior is measurable and defensible.

Apply ML fundamentals, including supervised and unsupervised learning, anomaly detection, natural language processing, time-series, and statistical inference, to the employer-signal and real-world-evidence domains.

Develop, fine-tune, and distill models, including small, specialized models trained on proprietary data, with appropriate governance and data controls.

Apply modern LLM techniques, including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, and knowledge-graph methods, to ground AI reasoning in trusted, cited sources.

Design reusable, horizontal AI capabilities that can be surfaced across multiple downstream experiences and teams, rather than rebuilding logic for each use case.

Ensure data quality, reproducibility, and auditability across all models and agentic workflows, consistent with a regulated environment.

Translate business problems into solvable AI problems and communicate insights and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Conduct research and stay current with the AI frontier, bringing emerging agentic, evaluation, and model-training techniques into the team's work.

Provide technical leadership, including setting the technical direction for agentic AI work, mentoring other team members, and defining evaluation and model-development standards for the team.

Manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously.

What You Should Bring

Foundational knowledge in communication, leadership, teamwork, problem solving, solution and blueprint definition, business acumen, architectural processes (e.g., blueprinting, reference architecture, governance), technical standards, project delivery, and the industry.

Business Analysis And Technical Leadership, Including

Engaging with the business and proactively seeking opportunities to deliver business value.

Understanding business requirements and effectively translating business needs and processes into technical terms, and vice versa.

Eliciting and defining requirements.

Ensuring appropriate business roles are engaged in solution execution.

Participating in design reviews to ensure traceability of requirements.

Networking with appropriate Technology at Lilly colleagues to determine solutions that meet business partners' needs.

Seeking opportunities to reuse existing processes and services to streamline support and implementation of key systems.

Staying abreast of tools and technologies to influence Technology at Lilly strategy so that it provides the best usage opportunities for the business.

Basic Qualifications

PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative or technical field, with at least 4 + years of experience developing, deploying, or maintaining AI, machine learning, or data systems in production environments.

OR Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative or technical field, with at least 6 + years of experience developing, deploying, or maintaining AI, machine learning, or data systems in production environments.

OR Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative or technical field, with at least 8 + years of experience developing, deploying, or maintaining AI, machine learning, or data systems in production environments.

Preferred Qualifications

A track record of delivering LLM or agentic AI solutions into production that produced measurable business results.

Strong foundation in machine learning algorithms and statistical analysis.

Proficiency in Python.

Proven experience providing technical leadership, such as setting the technical direction of AI or ML projects, mentoring data scientists or engineers, or defining standards for model development and evaluation.

Agentic AI: experience designing agent-to-agent orchestration and multi-agent workflows with modern agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent), including tool use and autonomous reasoning loops.

AI evaluation: experience building evaluation and benchmarking approaches for LLM and agentic systems, including groundedness, hallucination, and reliability measurement, and integrating evaluation into the development lifecycle.

LLM techniques: experience with prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and fine-tuning or distillation of small, specialized models.

ML fundamentals: experience with supervised and unsupervised learning, anomaly detection, NLP, time-series, and uncertainty quantification.

Platforms and tooling: experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, Databricks, SQL and NoSQL data stores, deep learning frameworks, common data-manipulation libraries, Git, and CI/CD.

Domain: previous experience in healthcare, pharma, payer or employer, or real-world evidence.

Demonstrated ability to analyze large, complex data domains, to craft practical, measurable AI solutions, and to communicate with a geographically dispersed group of business and technical colleagues.

Lilly IT builds and maintains capabilities with cutting-edge technologies, as the most prominent tech companies do. Lilly IT is different because we use technology to advance our purpose: creating medicines that make life better for people around the world. new_jobs.description:
Overview

Come join the TurboTax CRM and Lifecycle Marketing data science team as a Staff Data Scientist. We design how Intuit engages customers across owned channels to drive retention, product engagement, and long-term customer value. Our mission is to accelerate decision-making through advanced models, causal measurement, and experimentation that address our most important customer and business challenges.

This role will be pivotal in shifting CRM from campaign-level optimization to customer journey design: defining the metrics and causal levers the business manages to, designing learning plans that resolve the highest-stakes decisions, and building the measurement and data products the lifecycle marketing organization depends on. You will operate as a senior individual contributor, partnering closely with Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Tax leadership to identify, validate, and refine strategies that move customers through behavioral milestones — not just messages — and compound into retention and lifetime value.

The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of lifecycle marketing, causal inference, and AI-native analytics. You frame the right question before any analysis runs, with a command of the domain that others check their own framing against. This is a high-impact role where your work will directly influence how TurboTax invests in CRM, which journeys get built, and how we know they are working.

Responsibilities

Drive Lifecycle Marketing Strategy through Data — Frame the right question self-directed, before analysis is requested. Translate ambiguous marketing and product problems into analytical frameworks, metric trees, and testable hypotheses that alter the CRM roadmap and resource decisions. Partner with Tax leadership and the Lifecycle Marketing team to define north-star metrics, align on learning plans, and establish what success looks like at each stage of the customer journey — from re-engagement and start through completion, attach, and return the following year.

Causal Measurement that Changes Business Decisions — Apply causal inference and counterfactual reasoning to isolate what actually moved a metric — campaign incrementality, journey-level lift, channel mix, halo, and retention — and change the business-area decision it feeds. Design and run experiments, quasi-experiments, holdouts, and synthetic tests when a clean A/B is not available.

Cross-Functional Influence — Serve as the strategic data science partner to leaders across Marketing, Product, Data Engineering, Finance, and adjacent growth teams (paid acquisition, Credit Karma, in-product messaging). Translate complex analytical findings into clear recommendations for Director- and VP-level stakeholders, and drive the work through to the decision in whatever medium lands — slack, readout, model, or working session.

Insights, Journeys & Customer Value at Scale — Conduct deep-dive analyses on customer journeys, audience segments, funnel and cohort performance, and lifetime value to inform where CRM has the most leverage. Design segmentation and personalization strategies that improve targeting, reduce wasted volume, and free messaging capacity for high-value journeys. Create dashboards, visualizations, and self-serve tools — including GenAI-powered applications — so marketing and leadership can act quickly.

AI-Native Measurement, Data Products & Agentic Systems — Identify, size, and prioritize AI use cases for CRM (personalization, journey orchestration, insight generation) against business value, and apply evaluation frameworks (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge with human review, synthetic tests) so non-deterministic experiences can be certified rather than shipped on vibes. Build and maintain the data products the business area and its agents depend on: prototype the data model, pipeline, and surface, then partner with engineering to harden what sticks. Automate recurring analytical bottlenecks into trusted agentic systems that stakeholders can run independently, with encoded business logic, monitoring, and a clear call on what may run without a human in the loop. Champion data hygiene, instrumentation, and decision governance across CRM reporting and campaign measurement.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate is a curious, self-directed data scientist with experience building scalable solutions, a deep understanding of customer behavior, and the judgment to balance statistical rigor with business speed.

8+ years of experience in data science and analytics, with a track record of driving strategy and impact across a business area (CRM, lifecycle marketing, growth, retention, or equivalent); consumer subscription, fintech, or large-scale owned-channel marketing experience strongly preferred.
Demonstrated ability to apply first-principles thinking to translate ambiguous business strategy into analytical problems at the business-area level — framing the question before analysis runs, rather than waiting for one to be handed down.
Proven success designing and interpreting complex experiments well beyond traditional A/B testing, and applying causal inference where experimentation is constrained (holdouts, quasi-experiments, incrementality, MMM or multi-touch attribution as inputs — not substitutes — for causal claims).
Deep expertise in causal inference, customer segmentation, journey analytics, and experimentation design, with the judgment to balance statistical rigor and business considerations.
Experience building and owning predictive models through their lifecycle (classification, regression, propensity, or similar) and being accountable for the decisions they inform, not just model accuracy.
Experience creating reusable frameworks, methodologies, and data products that are adopted by a broader analytics and marketing community.
Fluency in SQL and a statistical programming language (Python or R); experience partnering with engineering to harden pipelines, instrumentation, and production data products.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder-influence skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence Director- and VP-level leaders across business and technical teams.
Ability to navigate ambiguity with minimal guidance, make fast data-driven decisions (one-way vs. two-way door), and operate effectively in a fast-paced, seasonal business.
Ability to use AI-native tools to plan, implement, and synthesize analyses across experiment readouts, quasi-experimental methods, revenue and retention deep dives, and measuring the success of journey or campaign launches. Comfort sizing AI use cases and evaluating non-deterministic systems, not only using AI as a personal productivity tool.
BS or MS in Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Engineering, Econometrics, or a related field (advanced degree preferred).

Nice to have

Hands-on experience with CRM platforms (e.g., Braze) and owned-channel measurement (email, push, SMS, in-app).
Experience designing journey-level measurement (behavioral milestones, coordinated intent) alongside campaign-level operational metrics.
Familiarity with marketing mix models, multi-touch attribution, and when not to treat them as causal evidence.

new_jobs.description:
About Finch

Our mission is to make justice radically more accessible to every American household.

We combine expert operators with purpose-built AI to automate the admin work of consumer law and put clients first by handling intake, claim opening, medical records, police reports, lien management, demands, and everything in between.

Since launching in April 2025, we’ve raised a $20M Series A backed by Sequoia, Redpoint, and the founders & CEOs of DoorDash, Ironclad, and Digits and are running pre-litigation for over 125 of the highest-volume personal injury firms across the country.

Explore life at Finch for more.

A note from Ben

Hey, I’m Ben, CTO at Finch. I’m hiring engineers who can (a) understand what needs to be built and why, (b) ship quality work fast, and (c) own the outcomes tied to measurable legal impact.

We have an exceptionally talented group of high-personality, collaborative engineers. Nothing matters more to me than keeping that true as we grow.

The three reasons engineers generally come to (and stay at) Finch are:

High ownership and freedom to build. We give you a problem-space and lots of room to shape the product solution.
Meaningful impact and a tight feedback loop. Your work supports real people through difficult moments in their life (i.e. personal injury cases), and you sit next to users.
Applied AI work and room to experiment. We are building at the cutting edge of legal AI application.

If this sounds exciting, please apply.

What you'll do

Personal injury law is full of repetitive tasks, paper-based bottlenecks, and fragmented data. As a Member of Technical Staff, Applied AI, you’ll build agents that move cases forward and make those workflows dependable. You’ll own critical features end-to-end, ship fast, and work directly alongside strategy & operations, product, design, and legal teammates in a codebase where your decisions matter from day one.

Build production-grade voice, browser, document, and workflow agents that move personal injury cases forward.
Design long-horizon agent systems, including context, tools, memory, permissions, structured outputs, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Own the eval flywheel: turn real cases and operator feedback into benchmarks that continuously improve agent quality.
Optimize performance through model selection and routing, context engineering, prompting, tool design, and agent observability.
Make agents reliable across calls, documents, communications, and third-party portals, including when systems fail or case information changes.
Evaluate advances in agentic AI and rapidly ship the ones that improve quality, speed, or cost.

What will make you successful

This role is for technical team members who want ownership over outcomes - here's what we think that requires.

You’ll likely thrive if you have

2+ years of experience building reliable, secure software in production, with the ability to own systems across the stack.
Experience shipping AI-powered products or agents beyond the prototype stage.
Experience designing practical evals and using them to understand agent behavior, compare approaches, and improve task-completion quality.
Proficiency in Python and comfort working with React, LLM APIs, and agent frameworks.
Strong instincts for agent design, including context construction, model selection, tool boundaries, structured outputs, failure recovery, and human handoffs.
A track record of turning ambiguous, real-world workflows into simple, dependable systems.
An experimental mindset: you move quickly, measure what matters, and care more about whether an agent completes the job correctly than whether the approach is clever.

It’s a plus if you have

Experience with Pydantic AI or another production agent framework.
Experience building voice agents, browser agents, or long-running workflow agents.
Familiarity with Django, React, Temporal, Playwright, or AWS.
Experience building evaluation systems, agent observability, model routing, or human-in-the-loop review tools.
Familiarity with legal tech, healthcare workflows, document processing, or other operationally complex domains.

This role may not be for you if

You prefer a role where the roadmap, process, and success metrics are already defined.
You are looking for a narrow remit rather than meaningful ownership across a fast-moving team.
You’re looking for a remote-first role. We work together in our NYC office four days a week.

What happens next

We aim to run a human, efficient process. That generally includes:

Intro: An initial conversation about your background, motivation, and the role.
Technical interview: A practical, technical session with an engineer.
Onsite: A visit to our NYC office to interview, meet the team, and have lunch.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Principal Data Scientist – Market Access
new_jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Do you want to build agentic AI systems that reach real patients and inform real business decisions?

The Lilly USA Technology at Lilly Market Access team is seeking a Senior Principal Data Scientist to design and build the next generation of agentic AI and machine learning solutions across our employer-intelligence and real-world-evidence initiatives. You will work with internal business and Technology at Lilly partners to solve complex, high-volume problems with intelligent, autonomous, and measurable AI systems that scale horizontally across use cases.

What You'll Be Doing

As a Senior Principal Data Scientist, you will analyze complex data, develop predictive and generative models, and design agentic AI systems that solve genuine business problems in the employer and real-world-evidence spaces. You will own the AI reasoning layer end to end, from framing the problem and designing multi-agent workflows to building the models and evaluation frameworks that make these systems trustworthy. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand business problems, develop hypotheses, and test them with data and rigorous evaluation. You will build reusable, horizontal capabilities rather than one-off solutions.

How You'll Succeed

Design and build agentic AI systems, including agent-to-agent orchestration, multi-agent workflows, tool and environment use, and autonomous reasoning loops that act on real systems.

Build rigorous AI evaluation frameworks, including groundedness and hallucination measurement, benchmark design, regression testing, confidence and uncertainty estimation, and human-in-the-loop review, so AI behavior is measurable and defensible.

Apply ML fundamentals, including supervised and unsupervised learning, anomaly detection, natural language processing, time-series, and statistical inference, to the employer-signal and real-world-evidence domains.

Develop, fine-tune, and distill models, including small, specialized models trained on proprietary data, with appropriate governance and data controls.

Apply modern LLM techniques, including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, and knowledge-graph methods, to ground AI reasoning in trusted, cited sources.

Design reusable, horizontal AI capabilities that can be surfaced across multiple downstream experiences and teams, rather than rebuilding logic for each use case.

Ensure data quality, reproducibility, and auditability across all models and agentic workflows, consistent with a regulated environment.

Translate business problems into solvable AI problems and communicate insights and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Conduct research and stay current with the AI frontier, bringing emerging agentic, evaluation, and model-training techniques into the team's work.

Provide technical leadership, including setting the technical direction for agentic AI work, mentoring other team members, and defining evaluation and model-development standards for the team.

Manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously.

What You Should Bring

Foundational knowledge in communication, leadership, teamwork, problem solving, solution and blueprint definition, business acumen, architectural processes (e.g., blueprinting, reference architecture, governance), technical standards, project delivery, and the industry.

Business Analysis And Technical Leadership, Including

Engaging with the business and proactively seeking opportunities to deliver business value.

Understanding business requirements and effectively translating business needs and processes into technical terms, and vice versa.

Eliciting and defining requirements.

Ensuring appropriate business roles are engaged in solution execution.

Participating in design reviews to ensure traceability of requirements.

Networking with appropriate Technology at Lilly colleagues to determine solutions that meet business partners' needs.

Seeking opportunities to reuse existing processes and services to streamline support and implementation of key systems.

Staying abreast of tools and technologies to influence Technology at Lilly strategy so that it provides the best usage opportunities for the business.

Basic Qualifications

PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative or technical field, with at least 4 + years of experience developing, deploying, or maintaining AI, machine learning, or data systems in production environments.

OR Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative or technical field, with at least 6 + years of experience developing, deploying, or maintaining AI, machine learning, or data systems in production environments.

OR Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative or technical field, with at least 8 + years of experience developing, deploying, or maintaining AI, machine learning, or data systems in production environments.

Preferred Qualifications

A track record of delivering LLM or agentic AI solutions into production that produced measurable business results.

Strong foundation in machine learning algorithms and statistical analysis.

Proficiency in Python.

Proven experience providing technical leadership, such as setting the technical direction of AI or ML projects, mentoring data scientists or engineers, or defining standards for model development and evaluation.

Agentic AI: experience designing agent-to-agent orchestration and multi-agent workflows with modern agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent), including tool use and autonomous reasoning loops.

AI evaluation: experience building evaluation and benchmarking approaches for LLM and agentic systems, including groundedness, hallucination, and reliability measurement, and integrating evaluation into the development lifecycle.

LLM techniques: experience with prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and fine-tuning or distillation of small, specialized models.

ML fundamentals: experience with supervised and unsupervised learning, anomaly detection, NLP, time-series, and uncertainty quantification.

Platforms and tooling: experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, Databricks, SQL and NoSQL data stores, deep learning frameworks, common data-manipulation libraries, Git, and CI/CD.

Domain: previous experience in healthcare, pharma, payer or employer, or real-world evidence.

Demonstrated ability to analyze large, complex data domains, to craft practical, measurable AI solutions, and to communicate with a geographically dispersed group of business and technical colleagues.

About The Organization

Lilly IT builds and maintains capabilities with cutting-edge technologies, as the most prominent tech companies do. Lilly IT is different because we use technology to advance our purpose: creating medicines that make life better for people around the world. Examples include data-driven drug discovery, connected clinical trials, and AI that helps patients access and afford their medicines. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of our business.

The Lilly USA Technology at Lilly team is at the forefront of leveraging data and technology to launch new medicines to market, raise awareness, and help appropriate patients get access to medication. We partner closely with Lilly's market access organization, which works with payers, employers, and government customers to improve affordability and broaden access. With a deep technical and business understanding, working across all therapeutic areas and disease states, we design and implement digital solutions to power our business. We use real-world evidence and health outcomes data to reduce friction across the patient journey, create best-in-class customer engagements, improve patient outcomes, and deliver business results.
